name: Cone of Boiling Acid, Lesser
body:
School evocation [acid, fire]; Level magus 4, shaman 5, sorcerer/wizard 4, witch 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a piece of coal in a vial of acid)

EFFECT

Range 30 ft.
Area cone-shaped burst
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You burst forth with a spray of boiling acid. Each creature within the cone takes 1d6 damage per caster level (maximum 10d6). Half of the damage is acid, the other half is fire.
